    print('page', page_index, 'count', len(page))
    if not page:
        break
    all_playlists.extend(page)
    page_index += 1

# print titles and ids
for p in all_playlists:
    print(p['playlist_id'], p['title'], 'songs', len(p.get('song_ids', [])))

# Compute most common genre per playlist, using cached show_song result for song_id=28
from collections import Counter

song_cache = {28: song_sample}  # reuse sample

playlist_genre_info = []
for pl in all_playlists:
    genres = []
    for sid in pl['song_ids']:
        if sid in song_cache:
            song = song_cache[sid]
        else:
            song = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
            song_cache[sid] = song
        # Use song's own 'genre' field
        genres.append(song.get('genre'))
    cnt = Counter(genres)
    max_count = max(cnt.values()) if cnt else None
    # Tie-break: earliest first appearance in the playlist order
    candidates = {g for g,c in cnt.items() if c==max_count}
    first_idx = {g: next(i for i,x in enumerate(genres) if x==g) for g in candidates}
    most_common = min(first_idx, key=first_idx.get) if candidates else None
    playlist_genre_info.append({
        'playlist_id': pl['playlist_id'],
        'original_title': pl['title'],
        'genres': genres,
        'genre_counts': dict(cnt),
        'most_common_genre': most_common,
        'max_count': max_count
    })

for info in playlist_genre_info:
    print(info['playlist_id'], info['original_title'], 'most_common_genre:', info['most_common_genre'], 'count:', info['max_count'])
    print(' genres:', info['genres'])
    print(' counts:', info['genre_counts'])

# Update playlist titles with most common genre
updates = []
for info in playlist_genre_info:
    plid = info['playlist_id']
    old_title = info['original_title']
    mcg = info['most_common_genre']
    new_title = f"{old_title} | {mcg}"
    res = apis.spotify.update_playlist(playlist_id=plid, access_token=spotify_token, title=new_title)
    updates.append({
        'playlist_id': plid,
        'old_title': old_title,
        'most_common_genre': mcg,
        'new_title': new_title,
        'update_res': res
    })

for u in updates:
    print(u['playlist_id'], u['old_title'], '=>', u['new_title'])
    print('update_res:', u['update_res'])

# Verification pass: ensure playlist titles updated
expected_titles = {u['playlist_id']: u['new_title'] for u in updates}
verification = []
all_ok = True
for plid, exp_title in expected_titles.items():
    pl = apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=plid, access_token=spotify_token)
    got_title = pl.get('title')
    ok = (got_title == exp_title)
    all_ok = all_ok and ok
    verification.append({'playlist_id': plid, 'expected': exp_title, 'got': got_title, 'ok': ok})

for v in verification:
    print(v)
print('all_ok:', all_ok)

# Complete task only if all titles match
if all_ok:
    res = apis.supervisor.complete_task()
    print('complete_task_res:', res)
else:
    print('Not completing due to mismatch')
